title: Integrability under a Gaussian noise shift
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, let $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ be integrable with respect to the product standard Gaussian measure $\gamma_n$, and fix any $x\in\mathbb R^n$. Then $y\mapsto f(\rho x+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,y)$ is integrable with respect to $\gamma_n$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a fixed vector in $\mathbb R^n$
